_meta.rule_under_test: R4 (lot number absent) + R5 (CoA not referenced)
_meta.direction: NEGATIVE (should FLAG — 2 flags in same section → ESCALATE)
_meta.description: Two S.5 findings for the same submission. F-030 has a rationale that mentions the working standard and source but omits lot number (R4 fires) and CoA (R5 fires) — two FLAGs on ONE finding. F-031 is a clean PASS. Because F-030 carries 2 flags and they are both in 3.2.S.5, R4+R5 do NOT individually exceed the section-escalation threshold (threshold counts findings, not flags per finding). However F-030 has 2 flag REASONS, so its status is FLAG; with only 1 flagged finding in the section, it stays FLAG and is NOT escalated by the section rule. This scenario demonstrates that the section escalation counts distinct FLAGGED FINDINGS, not the number of flag reasons on a single finding.
_meta.author: M5
